judgment.rationale: There is an assigned maintainer and an explicit public implementation attempt, not merely an empty ownership signal. The original LibreOffice problem remains unresolved; later evidence was supplied and is awaiting maintainer analysis.
evidence: Restarting Command Palette did not help; the author supplied the shared Start Menu shortcut location and March diagnostic archives.

https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/issues/45913#issuecomment-4082783124 says the assigned maintainer is rewriting the module and adding enumeration safeguards, without reproducing LibreOffice directly.
Enabling PATH apps fixed Kitty but explicitly did not fix LibreOffice.
July 14 reports still-missing LibreOffice and non-launching MakeMKV; the newly requested ZIP was attached at issuecomment-4967655084.
The August Chrome-app commenter reported a separate workaround; that does not resolve the original report.
judgment.recommended_action: The assigned maintainer should examine the supplied diagnostics and compare the ongoing discovery work with the remaining LibreOffice/MakeMKV cases.

fix_assessment.rationale: The assigned maintainer explicitly describes an app-enumeration rewrite as the existing implementation attempt. No linked PR or shipped resolution is established; coverage of the original missing-app case remains unverified.

issue_context.summary: Command Palette misses LibreOffice Start Menu shortcuts despite supplied diagnostics. The assigned maintainer is investigating app enumeration; a PATH setting fixed Kitty only.
known_information: The report includes Start Menu versus Command Palette screenshots.
Restart, PATH/registry settings, and multiple diagnostic submissions have already been discussed.
The maintainer's latest request for a MakeMKV-related report was answered.
The issue remains open and assigned to jiripolasek.
inferences: The distinct PATH-only and Start Menu cases should not be assumed to share one cause or one resolution.
issue_context.analysis: The old generic evidence request ignored answers already present. Existing explicit maintainer implementation work and unanswered supplied diagnostics make maintainer resumption preferable to duplicate design work.
